Hi Sophie —

Following up from Ava's note. A couple of specifics from Finance so you can complete the CSV without back-and-forth:

• We require the CSV to include the PO number column for every row. If an invoice is not tied to a PO, please write "NO-PO" in the PO column.
• Remittance string should be in this exact format: "PO#{PO_NUMBER} | INV#{INVOICE_NUMBER} | LUMN". Example: "PO#501237 | INV#2026-987 | LUMN".
• For ACH, we need the ABA routing number and account number in separate columns (no dashes or spaces).
• Account type must be one of: checking, savings.

Operational notes: we will create the vendor record in our system before initiating micro-deposits. Priyom — once the record exists please confirm to this thread and Finance will send micro-deposits (expected 1–3 business days). If you prefer a wire for the kickoff, we can process that but will require the bank's SWIFT/BIC and beneficiary details in full.

Sophie, if you can re-upload the CSV to the secure folder in the HubSpot company record (link below) or reply with the cleaned file, we'll proceed.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
